income.title: {{adjective}} Income
income.emptyDescription: Revenue sources, fiscal autonomy, and national tax dependency.
income.description: The Bureau of Local Government Finance's Annual Regular Income and Dependencies for {{lgu}}: where its regular income comes from, and how much of it is raised locally.
income.annualRevenue: As stated by BLGF for the fiscal year
income.lsrShare: Share of annual regular income raised locally
income.allotmentShare: Share of annual regular income from the allotment
income.definition: BLGF defines annual regular income as locally sourced revenue (real property tax for the general fund, tax on business, other taxes, regulatory fees, service charges and receipts from economic enterprises) plus the allotment, other shares from national tax collections and interest income. Each dependency is BLGF's own ratio of that source to annual regular income.

items.otherShares: Other Shares from National Tax Collection

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness
competitiveness.description: National evaluation of local government progress across pillars of governance and development.
competitiveness.methodologyNote: Scores are shown for each year as DTI published them. DTI scored three pillars up to 2016, added Resiliency in 2017 and Innovation in 2022, and changes the indicators within pillars between editions, so the overall score is a sum over a different set of measures before and after each change.
competitiveness.byYearCaption: Overall score and rank by CMCI edition, with the DTI page for each year
competitiveness.indicatorsWithheld: Indicator scores withheld for this pillar
competitiveness.indicatorsWithheldDetail: DTI's {{year}} profile lists indicator scores for this pillar that do not add up to its pillar score, and its chart names an indicator the table leaves out. The pillar score and rank are shown; the breakdown is not.
